name: Human Fighter 6/Rogue 4 (CR 9)
body:
HUMAN FIGHTER 6/ROGUE 4
CR 9

XP 6,400
Human fighter 6/rogue 4
N Medium humanoid (human)
Init +9; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 15, flat-footed 15 (+5 armor, +5 Dex)
hp 71 (6d10+4d8+10)
Fort +7, Ref +11 (+1 bonus vs. traps.), Will +4; +6 vs. fear
Defensive Abilities bravery +2, evasion, trap sense, uncanny dodge

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee +1 rapier +15/+10 (1d6+4/17–20) and +1 dagger +15/+10 (1d4+6/17–20)
Special Attacks sneak attack +2d6, weapon training (light blades +1)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 21, Con 13, Int 12, Wis 8, Cha 10
Base Atk +9; CMB +11; CMD 26
Feats Dazzling Display, Improved Critical, Improved Initiative, Improved Two-weapon Fighting, Iron Will, Skill Focus (acrobatics), Skill Focus (intimidate), Two-weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (dagger), Weapon Focus (rapier), Weapon Specialization (dagger)
Skills Acrobatics +21, Appraise +5 (+7 for small or highly detailed items when using a magnifying glass), Bluff +9, Climb +9, Craft (ships) +5, Diplomacy +4, Disable Device +14, Disguise +4, Escape Artist +9, Intimidate +14, Knowledge (local) +5, Perception +9 (+11 to locate traps.; only –1/20 ft. while using a spyglass, instead of –1/10 ft.), Profession (sailor) +10, Ride +9, Sense Motive +4, Sleight of Hand +9, Stealth +15, Survival +4, Swim +10
Languages Aquan, Common
SQ rogue talent (finesse rogue), rogue talent (weapon training), trapfinding +2
Gear potion of disguise self, potion of spider climb; Other Gear +1 chain shirt, +1 rapier, +1 dagger, belt of incredible dexterity +2, boots of elvenkind, cloak of the manta ray, magnifying glass, spyglass, masterwork thieves’ tools
